say:3:1320323001:1.text: C-Chippy didn't expect to see that many eyes on a bat's wings...
say:3:1320323001:1.source_cn: 没、没想到目蝠的翅膀上居然长了这么多只眼睛……

say:4:1320323002:1.text: Chippy, man up! Just collect the dust with your eyes closed. I'll be right here to guide you.
say:4:1320323002:1.source_cn: 满满别怕，闭着眼睛收集就好，我会在旁边指导你的！

say:5:1320323003:1.text: Alright... Chippy can do this... Chippy is a brave knight...

say:7:1320323004:1.text: Your strength is impressive. I never expected defeating the oculus bat to be this easy.
say:7:1320323004:1.source_cn: 你的力量很强大。我从没想过战胜目蝠会是这么容易的一件事。

choice_prompt:8:1320323004.text: Your strength is impressive. I never expected defeating the oculus bat to be this easy.
choice_prompt:8:1320323004.source_cn: 你的力量很强大。我从没想过战胜目蝠会是这么容易的一件事。

say:10:1320323006:1.text: When I was young... or rather, when I was still alive, I dreamed of searching for materials myself and creating the finest paint.
say:10:1320323006:1.source_cn: 年少时……或者说，还活着的时候，我一直想要亲自寻找原材...
say:10:1320323006:1.male: When I was young... or rather, when I was still alive, I dreamed of searching for materials myself and creating the finest paint.
say:10:1320323006:1.female: When I was young... or rather, when I was still alive, I dreamed of searching for materials myself and creating the finest paint.

say:11:1320323007:1.text: Regrettably, my incurable genetic illness rendered me frail, making even travel a daunting task. The prospect of venturing into remote areas and confronting monsters was simply beyond my grasp.
say:11:1320323007:1.source_cn: 但因为那种无法治愈的遗传病，我身体孱弱，连远行都极为困...
say:11:1320323007:1.male: Regrettably, my incurable genetic illness rendered me frail, making even travel a daunting task. The prospect of venturing into remote areas and confronting monsters was simply beyond my grasp.
say:11:1320323007:1.female: Regrettably, my incurable genetic illness rendered me frail, making even travel a daunting task. The prospect of venturing into remote areas and confronting monsters was simply beyond my grasp.

say:12:1320323008:1.text: The thought of ever creating anything on my own felt completely unattainable... My greatest longing back then was simply to run and play in the sunlight, just like everyone else.
say:12:1320323008:1.source_cn: 亲手制作颜料……是一个遥不可及的梦想。我当时最大的心愿...
say:12:1320323008:1.male: The thought of ever creating anything on my own felt completely unattainable... My greatest longing back then was simply to run and play in the sunlight, just like everyone else.
say:12:1320323008:1.female: The thought of ever creating anything on my own felt completely unattainable... My greatest longing back then was simply to run and play in the sunlight, just like everyone else.

say:13:1320323009:1.text: I spent most of my days in a gloomy room, where I could almost hear the footsteps of death drawing near...
say:13:1320323009:1.source_cn: 那时的我一直待在幽暗的房间里，似乎都能听到死亡来临前的...
say:13:1320323009:1.male: I spent most of my days in a gloomy room, where I could almost hear the footsteps of death drawing near...
say:13:1320323009:1.female: I spent most of my days in a gloomy room, where I could almost hear the footsteps of death drawing near...

say:14:1320323010:1.text: Yet now, I yearn for complete oblivion. It's a bitter irony, isn't it?
say:14:1320323010:1.source_cn: 然而现在，我却向往着彻底的消亡。真讽刺，不是吗。
say:14:1320323010:1.male: Yet now, I yearn for complete oblivion. It's a bitter irony, isn't it?
say:14:1320323010:1.female: Yet now, I yearn for complete oblivion. It's a bitter irony, isn't it?

choice_prompt:15:1320323010.female: Yet now, I yearn for complete oblivion. It's a bitter irony, isn't it?

say:16:1320323011:1.text: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.
say:16:1320323011:1.source_cn: ……或许，我和曾经活着的那个柳博米尔，已经不是同一个人了。
say:16:1320323011:1.male: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.
say:16:1320323011:1.female: Perhaps... I'm no longer the same Ludovic who once lived.

say:18:1320323013:1.text: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!
say:18:1320323013:1.source_cn: 主人，我们收集完菌丝粉了！
say:18:1320323013:1.male: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!
say:18:1320323013:1.female: Magister, we've finished collecting all the dust!

say:19:1320323014:1.text: Ludovic, you seem down... Is something wrong?
say:19:1320323014:1.source_cn: 咦……？柳博米尔，你的表情怎么好像有点不对劲？出什么事了吗？

say:21:1320323016:1.text: Let's search for wood to make the frame. I know where the perfect tree is. Come along.
say:21:1320323016:1.source_cn: 去找制作画框的木材吧。我知道哪里有合适的树木，跟我来。

say:23:1320323012:1.text: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...
say:23:1320323012:1.source_cn: 嗯，这算是为数不多的好事……
say:23:1320323012:1.male: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...
say:23:1320323012:1.female: I suppose that counts as one of the few positives...

choice:15:1:2.text: You've at least met your past wishes.
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 至少你还能实现曾经的心愿
choice:15:1:2.male: You've at least met your past wishes.
choice:15:1:2.female: You've at least met your past wishes.

choice:8:0:1.text: I thought you often came to get materials.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 我还以为你会经常来收集原料呢
choice:8:0:1.male: I thought you often came to get materials.
choice:8:0:1.female: I thought you often came to get materials.
